      @GetMapping @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<org.springframework.data.domain.Page<UserResponse>> listUsers(@PageableDefault(page=0,size=10,sort="createdAt",direction=DESC) org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Lists all registered users in paginated format. Only administrators may enumerate users.
      Parameters:
      pageable - pagination parameters (defaults to 10 users per page, newest first)
      Returns:
      200 OK with page of user responses

    • getUser

      @GetMapping("/{id}") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN') or @userSecurity.isUserOwner(#id, authentication.name)") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<UserResponse> getUser(@PathVariable Long id)
      Retrieves account details for a specific user ID. Accessible by system administrators or the account owner.
      Parameters:
      id - database ID from URL path
      Returns:
      200 OK with user profile details

    • createUser

      @PostMapping @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<UserResponse> createUser(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid CreateUserRequest request)
      Administratively provisions a new user account with role assignment. (Regular public registration is handled via /api/v1/auth/register).
      Parameters:
      request - validated user creation payload
      Returns:
      201 Created with Location header and user body

    • updateUser

      @PutMapping("/{id}") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN') or @userSecurity.isUserOwner(#id, authentication.name)") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<UserResponse> updateUser(@PathVariable Long id, @Valid @RequestBody @Valid UpdateUserRequest request)
      Updates an existing user's profile details. Accessible by system administrators or the account owner.
      Parameters:
      id - database ID of the user to modify
      request - validated update payload
      Returns:
      200 OK with the updated user profile

    • deleteUser

      @DeleteMapping("/{id}") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> deleteUser(@PathVariable Long id)
      Permanently removes a user account from the database. Only system administrators may perform this action.
      Parameters:
      id - database ID of the user to delete
